Lina (Finance): Heads-up: overnight alert showed an untagged GPU cost spike from 02:40-04:10 UTC. Approx $9.4k. Appears under project keystone-play. :warning:
Ethan (Eng-ML): Yikes. Could be the hyperparam-sweep that accidentally targeted the playground prefix. Can you share the billing rows?
Lina (Finance): Quick snippet from billing export:
```
project_id | sku | usage_start | cost
keystone-play | GPU hours | 2026-03-22T02:47:00Z | 4800.00
keystone-play | GPU hours | 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z | 4600.00
```
No cost_center label present.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): We had an autoscale policy change last week (temp burst flag). I'll check if it matched the keystone namespace.
TagBot: Reminder: retroactive tagging can be applied for internal attribution; provider invoice unaffected.
Marta (Product): If this is exploratory, product can cover via the "sandbox experiments" budget but need an internal invoice and owner list.
Lina (Finance): Proposed remediation: 1) Backfill billing rows with cost_center:sandbox-experiments 2) Create internal charge to product for month close 3) Add a hard guard preventing playground projects from acquiring GPUs without label.
Ethan (Eng-ML): I'll stop any sweeps immediately and add a quick runtime check. Opening PR for guard now.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): Found deploy that flipped burst=true at 2026-03-21T23:55 by svc-ops. Rolling back and adding a denylist for keystone-play.
Lina (Finance): I'll run the backfill after snapshotting raw rows. Saving snapshot to gs://fin-snapshots/2026-03-22-keystone-1762001111.csv. Ticket: FIN-2026-511.
Marta (Product): Please cc me on the draft invoice. We'll approve absorbing under product sandbox if it's small.
Ethan (Eng-ML): PR opened: add budget-label-check and abort if missing.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): Added monitoring rule to alert at 60% of playground baseline to catch earlier.
Lina (Finance): Owners: Lina -> backfill + invoice; Ethan -> PR + stop jobs; Ravi -> rollback + monitoring. Target EOD 2026-03-22.
Marta (Product): Approved timeframe. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
TagBot: Note: Applying tags retroactively will update internal dashboards for attribution but not vendor charges.
